rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: US equity market CLOSED (Sunday) — spot crypto is the only eligible instrument. The ETH flow picture INVERTED since yesterday's run: US spot Ethereum ETFs posted +$84.4M net inflows for the week ending 7/11, snapping an EIGHT-WEEK net-withdrawal streak (BTC+ETH complex together took in ~$282M on the week, ending a stretch that had drained ~$9.46B). Price confirms: ETH has broken above $1,770 and is pressing the multi-month descending trendline, with daily RSI now ABOVE 50 while BTC's RSI is still BELOW 50 — ETH is the momentum leader, not the laggard. June CPI lands Tuesday 7/14 and is expected to print a soft headline on collapsing gasoline; a cool number revives cut hopes into the 7/28-29 FOMC and the highest-beta major with positive flows gets the most torque. Fear & Greed 23 (extreme fear) means positioning is light.
positions.driver: This is a deliberate rotation OUT of the thesis that failed yesterday. BTC was bought on 7/11 precisely because its flows had flipped positive while ETH's were still bleeding; that asymmetry is now gone — BTC ETFs shed ~$95M on 7/10 and BTC has been rejected at $64.4K three separate times this week with RSI still sub-50. ETH now owns everything BTC owned yesterday (positive institutional flow, a defined technical trigger) PLUS a higher beta AND a compressed relative valuation: ETH/BTC sits near a 10-month low, so a market-wide risk bid mean-reverts the ratio in ETH's favor — the payoff is asymmetric in the direction we are pointed. Downside protection is real, not assumed: ETH sits directly on top of its 50-day (~$1,708) and 200-day (~$1,693) moving averages, a tight support cluster only ~6% below spot, which is what lets the stop be set tight. SOL ($76.87) rejected: has failed at $80 repeatedly and faded from Thursday with no fresh catalyst. XRP rejected: CLARITY-Act-levered but no confirming flow data. BTC rejected: safest but least upside and its edge just decayed. Spot and unleveraged — weekend books are thin and equity-listed leveraged crypto ETFs (BITX etc.) do not trade today, so leverage is unavailable regardless of conviction.
positions.risks: ETH is the higher-beta asset, so it cuts BOTH ways: in a weekend liquidation cascade on thin depth it falls harder than BTC — that is the explicit cost of the asymmetry we are buying. The weekly ETH inflow was choppy, not clean (7/10 alone saw ~$52M of ETH ETF OUTflows), so the flow inflection is one week old and could prove a head-fake. ETH is testing a descending trendline that has rejected it repeatedly since the peak; failure there sends it back toward $1,700. A HOT CPI on 7/14 kills the rate-cut path and pressures every risk asset, with ETH leading down. The structural bear regime is intact — ETH remains ~60% off its cycle high vs BTC's ~49%. Hard stop $1,695.40 (-6%), set TIGHTER than the 10% crypto default and placed just beneath the 50/200-DMA cluster so it triggers only on a genuine thesis break, not on noise.
